**The trap.** You add best-effort, flag-gated glue (governor mirror, ledger
hook, telemetry write) to an existing routine-action factory and default the
new parameter to the production implementation:

```ts
export function makeScoutCycleAction(
  runCycle: ScoutCycleRunner,
  buildDeps: ScoutTickDepsBuilder = productionDepsBuilder,
  recordGovernor = recordScoutTickToGovernor,   // ⟵ the trap
)
```

If your feature flag defaults **ON** (the repo's normal flag culture), every
existing unit test that invokes the factory's handler now runs the real glue:
`getFlag` returns the default (`true`) in a bare vitest process, the glue
resolves `getOrgPg()`, and — the sharp edge — `getOrgPg()`'s last-resort
fallback is `postgresql://…@localhost:5432/papercusp`, which on the dev box is
the **live operator DB**. The "hermetic" suite silently writes garbage rows
(e.g. `workspaceId: 'w'`) into live tables, or hangs/flakes on the connect
when PG isn't there. Nothing fails loudly at the seam you added.

**Why it's non-obvious.** Each layer behaves reasonably alone: flags
fail-safe to defaults with no PostHog; default-ON is the documented culture;
`getOrgPg()`'s `:5432` fallback is deliberate (the dev box really runs PG
there); best-effort glue swallows its errors. The composition is what bites —
and it bites tests that were *designed* PG-free (the factory header even says
so), which is exactly where nobody looks.

**The fix pattern (FB-01, learning-governor):**

- The factory takes the glue as an **optional param with NO production
  default** — omitted ⇒ skipped. Its PG-free unit-test contract survives.
- The **boot-path registrar** (the one production entry, e.g.
  `registerScoutCycleAction`) wires the real glue explicitly.
- A unit test pins the hermetic contract (handler runs with no recorder
  wired ⇒ no governor IO).

Handlers that are *already* PG-bound (e.g. `system:gym-cycle` calls
`getOrgPg()` itself) don't need this — adding glue there changes nothing
about their test posture.

**The pattern already recurred once** (2026-06-14, P-051): `makeScoutCycleAction`
grew a *second* glue seam, `workspaceCeilingGate` (the workspace-wide scout
spend ceiling preflight from `learning-governor/scout-ceiling.ts`), following
exactly this shape — an optional param with no production default, wired only
by `registerScoutCycleAction`, left unwired (and PG-free) in
`scout-cycle-action.test.ts`. That confirms the fix generalizes: every new
glue seam on this factory (and any other flag-gated-glue factory) needs the
same optional-param-no-default treatment, not just the first one.

**Check before you ship** (later frontier loops, FB-05..FB-15, wire glue the
same way): grep the factory's existing `.test.ts` — if its tests invoke the
handler without PG, your new default must not reach a pool. `enabled()`-first
ordering is not enough once the flag defaults ON.
